meta.promptText: Which sarees should I buy online in India for a wedding on a budget?

response.text:
If you’re shopping for a **wedding guest saree on a budget in India**, I’d aim for **₹1,000–₹2,500**. You can get a very festive look without paying for expensive pure silk.

### My best budget directions

**1. Tissue / organza with zari — best for a glam wedding look**  
These look much more expensive than they are, especially in jewel tones, champagne, pink, or lavender. Current options include tissue sarees around ₹1,800–₹2,400. [www.prashantisarees.com](https://www.prashantisarees.com/en-us/collections/sarees-under-3000?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

udget tissue and organza sarees for Indian wedding guests under ₹2500

**2. Banarasi-style silk — best traditional choice**  
Look for **art silk, soft silk, or silk-blend Banarasi** rather than “pure Katan silk” at this budget. Genuine heavy Katan Banarasi generally isn't realistic below ₹3,000–₹5,000. [mysilklove.com](https://mysilklove.com/collections/banarasi-sarees-under-3000?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[thepanaya.com](https://thepanaya.com/blogs/the-panaya/best-banarasi-sarees-under-rs-5000?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

udget Banarasi-style silk and art-silk sarees for weddings under ₹2500

**3. Georgette/chiffon with embellishment — best for comfort**  
Great if you'll be wearing it for several hours. A lightweight saree with a substantial border, sequins, or a nice blouse can look very wedding-appropriate without being heavy. Current wedding collections have plenty under ₹3,000. [hotdeals360.com](https://hotdeals360.com/fashion/wedding-guest-guide-elegant-ethnic-sets-and-sarees-under-3-000-10938544?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

udget embellished georgette and chiffon wedding guest sarees under ₹2000

### If I were buying one
I'd choose **a deep wine, emerald, royal blue, rani pink, or purple tissue/soft-silk saree with gold zari**, then spend a little extra on the **blouse and jewellery**. That's usually a better way to make a ₹1,500–₹2,000 saree look expensive than buying a ₹3,000 saree with a mediocre blouse.

For example, current listings include Koskii tissue/soft-raw-silk options around **₹1,494–₹1,794**, while other wedding-oriented options are available around ₹2,000–₹2,500. 

### [Koskii Navy Blue Soft Raw Silk Gold Saree]()
*₹1,494*

### [Koskii Rani Pink Tissue Gold Saree]()
*₹1,794*

### [Koskii Purple Tissue Gold Saree]()
*₹1,794*

### [Organza Tissue Zari Saree]()
*₹2,350*

### [Semi Matka Pichwai Saree]()
*₹2,394*

**One warning:** be skeptical of listings saying *“pure silk Banarasi”* for ₹500–₹1,000. At that price, it's often art silk/polyester or a printed Banarasi-style fabric rather than the genuine thing. [mysilklove.com](https://mysilklove.com/collections/banarasi-sarees-under-3000?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[thepanaya.com](https://thepanaya.com/blogs/the-panaya/best-banarasi-sarees-under-rs-5000?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

If you tell me your **budget (e.g. ₹1,000 / ₹2,000 / ₹3,000), age, skin tone, and whether you're the bride's friend/sister/cousin**, I can narrow it down to the most flattering styles and colours.
